newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: ALPINE SKIING-EDER TURNS BACK ON AUSTRIAN FEDERATION.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-EDER TURNS BACK ON AUSTRIAN FEDERATION.

text.p: Austrian slalom specialist Elfi Eder on Monday followed the example of her ski-jumping compatriot Andreas Goldberger by turning her back on the Austrian Ski Federation, Austrian newsagency APA said.

Eder, World Cup slalom champion of the 1995-96 season and silver medallist at the 1994 Lillehammer Olympics, has opted not to seek fresh membership of the federation so she is free -- like Goldberger -- to train with her own coach.
The Alpine republic's ski federation has been hit by other high-profile defections over disagreement of training methods.
The now-retired Marc Giradelli, a former overall World Cup champion, switched to competing for Luxembourg while slalom specialist Claudia Riegler now skis for New Zealand.
